title: Bloomsbury Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Bloomsbury is a stand alone guest cottage for two tucked away and surrounded by enchanting trees with a rear porch w/Adirondack seating. Great locations steps to all things Seaside, Florida!
description_expanded: Description107 SMOLIAN CIRCLE1 QUEENWelcome to Bloomsbury | A Classic Seaside Cottage RetreatWelcome to Bloomsbury, a charming and ideally located Seaside, Florida cottage designed for relaxed coastal living and unforgettable memories. Situated on a spacious corner lot at Forest Street and Smolian Circle, this peaceful hideaway places you just a 4-minute walk from Seaside’s private beach access and a short stroll to the West Side Pool, making it an exceptional home base for enjoying all that Seaside and Scenic Highway 30A have to offer.Outdoor Living Surrounded by NatureBloomsbury is tucked beneath mature trees and lush greenery, creating a shaded, tranquil setting that feels both private and welcoming. The outdoor space features a charcoal grill, outdoor shower, and generous yard area—perfect for casual cookouts, rinsing off after a beach day, or unwinding with a glass of wine while soaking in the laid-back rhythm of Seaside life. The corner-lot location also offers charming people-watching opportunities from the comfort of home.Comfortable First-Floor Bedroom & BathStep inside to an open foyer that leads to the home’s serene first-floor sleeping quarters. The queen primary bedroom is bright and inviting, with French doors opening to a private porch accented by a trellis and two Adirondack chairs—an ideal spot for morning coffee or a quiet evening wind-down. Just off the foyer, the full bathroom features a single vanity and walk-in shower, conveniently serving the main-level bedroom.Light-Filled Living Spaces UpstairsUpstairs, the second level opens into a sun-filled, open-concept living area designed for connection and relaxation. The thoughtfully equipped efficiency kitchen includes a compact refrigerator, microwave, dishwasher, two-burner electric cooktop, and coffee maker—perfect for easy meals and beach-day snacks (no oven). Adjacent to the kitchen, a dining table comfortably seats six for shared meals or game nights.Relaxed Gathering Space with Coastal CharmThe upstairs living room is the heart of Bloomsbury, offering comfortable seating, abundant natural light, and a flat-screen TV. This level is intentionally separate from the bedroom below, creating a peaceful balance between social space and private retreat—ideal for couples, small families, or friends traveling together.Your Seaside Escape AwaitsWhether you’re planning a weekend getaway or an extended stay along Florida’s iconic 30A, Bloomsbury offers a classic Seaside experience with an unbeatable location, inviting outdoor spaces, and relaxed coastal comfort. From beach days to sunset strolls through town, this charming cottage is ready to welcome you to the best of Seaside, FL.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. Features870 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spacePrivate Seaside residential beach access at West Ruskin Pavilion, part of the largest private residential beach on 30AJust 352 yards (approximately a 2-minute walk) to beach accessOutdoor grill for casual coastal cookoutsOutdoor shower, perfect after a day on the beachEfficiency kitchen with a compact refrigerator (no oven)Access to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities provided1 parking pass issued for one-bedroom homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners in Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR24-000917
